question: What is the national female workforce participation rate as per the Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25.51%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The national female workforce participation rate as per the Census of India 2011 is 0.2551 or 25.51%.
 
• This figure indicates the percentage of the female population that was engaged in the workforce at the time of the census.
 
• It highlights the challenges and barriers faced by women in accessing employment opportunities in India.
 
• Efforts have been made to increase this rate through various government and non-governmental initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years to collect comprehensive data on the demographic, economic, and social conditions of the population.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of India since 1872.
 
• It provides vital data used for planning, policy formulation, and allocation of resources by the government.
 
• The Census also includes detailed information on literacy rates, housing, and amenities, besides employment figures.
